subject: english
question:
The sentence has been divided into three parts, identify the error segment in the sentence given below. Choose no error if there is no error in the sentence.

Despite facing numerous challenges, she worked hardly / to achieve her goals and ultimately earned the well - deserved promotion

options.text: Despite facing numerous challenges, she worked hardly
to achieve her goals and ultimately

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the use of the word "**hardly**" instead of "**hard**."
 
• **"Hardly" means "barely" or "scarcely," which is not the intended meaning in this context.**
 
• The correct word should be "**hard**" to convey that she put in a lot of effort to achieve her goals.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 3** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Despite facing numerous challenges, she worked** hard **to achieve her goals and ultimately earned the well-deserved promotion."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **1) "earned the well-deserved promotion."** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **2) "no error"** – This would be the correct option if there were no mistakes in the sentence, but there is an error in part 3.
 
• **3) "Despite facing numerous challenges, she worked hardly "** – This part of the sentence contains the error where "hardly" should be replaced with "hard."
 
• **4) "to achieve her goals and ultimately,"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
